meta.description: Fetches company pages and writes one crawl bundle per company for the Signal scorer. Detection happens in Python, never here. See n8n/README.md; node parameters (sheet id, output path) are placeholders you must set, and node typeVersions may need bumping to match your n8n release.

nodes.name: Prospect list
nodes.notes: Columns: company, domain, industry, team_size. Credentials come from the credential store, never from a node field.

nodes.name: Loop Over Items
nodes.notes: One company in flight at a time, so one failure never takes the run with it.

nodes.name: Crawl allowed?
nodes.notes: False branch still writes a bundle, with allows_crawl false and no pages, so the report can say 'could not look' rather than the company silently disappearing.

nodes.name: Be polite
nodes.notes: n8n has no per-host throttle. This is the 1s spacing the Python client applies automatically. Do not remove it.

nodes.name: Assemble bundle
nodes.notes: Assembles and forwards only. No detection here: evidence quotes are substring-checked against page text in Python, and a detector on this side would leave the validator nothing to check.

nodes.name: Write bundle
nodes.notes: Point this at the directory you pass to run.py --bundles. Keep the files: re-scoring a saved corpus takes seconds and re-crawls nothing.
